title: Add spatial proximity (same_area, distance, intra-room hops) to subjective speech tone perception
goal: Make listener-side speech tone and vocal-strain perception physically grounded in spatial proximity (same area, cross-area distance, and intra-room hops).

sections.what: Extend perceive_speech_tone() in engine/speech_tone.py and SpeechBroadcaster._append_hearing_entry() in engine/speech.py so subjective tone and vocal-strain detection accounts for same_area, cross-area sound distance, and intra-room proximity_hops.
sections.why: Currently perceive_speech_tone() (engine/speech_tone.py:275-374) filters delivery tone only through speaker strain, listener mood, closeness, and Insight (WIS), ignoring physical distance. A listener in an adjacent area (distance >= 1) catches subtle vocal tightness on a casual/warm cover line as easily as someone standing two feet away, even though SpeechBroadcaster._append_hearing_entry() (engine/speech.py:251-317, 457, 502-507) already has distance and engine/character_spatial.py already computes intra-room proximity_hops() (lines 261-295).
sections.how:
1. Extend perceive_speech_tone() in engine/speech_tone.py (lines 275-374) with optional same_area: Optional[bool] = None, distance: Optional[int] = None, and proximity_hops: Optional[int] = None.
2. Dampen subtle vocal-strain detection (_speaker_is_strained, lines 200-230) and subtle sarcasm detection when same_area is False (distance >= 1) or when same_area is True across the room (proximity_hops is None when spatial hops were checked): cross-area listeners ignore non-overloaded micro-strain and only catch speaker_overloaded strain at distance == 1 with high closeness/Insight; distant listeners are also more likely to miss subtle sarcasm.
3. Update SpeechBroadcaster._append_hearing_entry() in engine/speech.py (lines 294-313) to compute same_area=(distance is None) and intra-room proximity_hops() via engine/character_spatial.py (lines 261-295) when both character node IDs exist in self.graph, forwarding them to perceive_speech_tone().
4. Forward optional same_area/distance/proximity_hops in prototypes/emotions/viwo_adapter.py so prototype appraisals match production speech tone filtering.
5. Add unit tests in tests/test_speech_tone.py covering same-area close vs across-room vs cross-area strain and sarcasm perception.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_speech_tone.py tests/test_sound.py tests/test_spatial_invariants.py prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py -v and verify same-area close listeners catch strained cover lines while adjacent-area listeners perceive the casual/warm delivery.

acceptance.text: perceive_speech_tone() in engine/speech_tone.py accepts optional same_area, distance, and proximity_hops parameters with full backwards compatibility when omitted.

Cross-area listeners (same_area=False or distance >= 1) and across-the-room listeners (same_area=True, proximity_hops=None) require stronger overload/closeness/Insight thresholds to detect subtle vocal strain or sarcasm than close same-area listeners (proximity_hops in (1, 2)).
SpeechBroadcaster._append_hearing_entry() in engine/speech.py passes same_area, distance, and derived proximity_hops() from engine/character_spatial.py into perceive_speech_tone().
tests/test_speech_tone.py verifies that a strained warm/teasing cover line leaks as strained to a close same-area listener while landing unstrained as warm/teasing to an adjacent-area listener.

custom.browser_ui: No new UI widgets required. Uses the existing #htc-tone selector (static/js/agent/human-turn-composer.ts) and witnessed/heard speech rendering in static/js/agent/prompt-builder/room-context.ts. Manual check: have a strained speaker deliver a warm or teasing cover line in one area while a close character stands beside them and another listener stands in an adjacent open area; verify the close listener prompt shows strained delivery while the distant listener prompt reads the intended casual/warm delivery.

evidence: pytest tests/test_speech_tone.py tests/test_sound.py tests/test_spatial_invariants.py prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py: 100 passed in 8.93s (including test_perceive_speech_tone_spatial_proximity and test_broadcast_speech_cross_area_distance_dampens_strain).
